faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in San Anselmo?
faq.answer: San Anselmo homeowners typically invest $7,000 to $16,000 for a full window replacement project. This charming Marin County town features Craftsman bungalows and Victorian cottages in the flats, as well as hillside properties with canyon views. Custom sizing for older period homes is common. Single window installation starts at approximately $590.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in San Anselmo?
faq.answer: Yes. San Anselmo requires a building permit for window replacements. Properties in the downtown historic corridor along Sir Francis Drake may require design review. Our team manages all Town of San Anselmo permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in San Anselmo?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in San Anselmo commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in San Anselmo?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most San Anselmo replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in San Anselmo?
faq.answer: Most San Anselmo projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
